test_status: retrospective_locked; prior full-history baseline results were already inspected
primary_test_comparison: original plus annual AHC_VALIDATED for HS, HG-Rs, VAL; PM unchanged; common cohort
secondary_test_comparison: at most one validation-selected granularity per empirical method, fixed before TEST
denominator_policy: OLS0 uses finite nonnegative x/y including zero; requires sum(x^2)>0. MEAN_RATIO excludes x=0 only for fitting ratios; no epsilon or clipping. Metrics include zero references.
missing_coefficient_policy: null with reason; no pooled/regional fallback; retain original baseline
climatology_policy: only after completed TEST; full-history annual OLS0; short-series coefficients descriptive only, not validated or deployable
stop_policy: TRAIN gates before validation; repeat robust block stability after TEST descriptively, before climatology; do not tune after a STOP
availability_evidence: availability-only projection of station/date/source states/input eligibility; no target/error magnitudes
threshold_status: pragmatic predeclared engineering/materiality criteria, not universal literature constants
